id: A page hidden from a role is also refused when its address is typed in (\"Block access to hidden pages\" is switched on). Users who can manage options, the dashboard, profile, UX Studio, Plugins, Users and Settings are never blocked. You will see the setting, with a note that it came from this migration, in UX Studio under Admin Customiser, Sidebar menu, \"Block access to hidden pages\", and you can switch it off there.
Switched on by the migration from the plugin %1$s (%2$s). %1$s blocked hidden pages, so the lock is switched on here too. You can switch it off.
comments: #. translators: 1: plugin name (Adminimize), 2: date of the migration.

id: Blocking of hidden pages: on (from the migration of %s)
